messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired - inference-queue.active > 85% on cell us-east-1-prod (autoscaler lagging)
pagerduty-bot: page triggered -> rotation: eng-oncall (high)
maya: seeing PD, joining now
jonas: pulling metrics and autoscaler controller logs
ravi: checking cloud provider responses and nodepool status
alex: initial impact: queue at ~87%, p95 latency jumped to ~2.8s from 0.7s, increased 500s on several customers
lina: CS reports multiple timeouts, a couple enterprise customers opened Sev2 tickets
ops_lead: acknowledged. immediate plan: 1) ack PD, 2) open bridge, 3) attempt alternate pool spin, 4) consider cross-region failover for non-sensitive routes
maya: acked PD incident-4287654321 :white_check_mark:
ops_lead: bridge created -> #incident-4287654321-bridge. Invites sent
jonas: autoscaler controller logs show repeated scale attempts failing with provider error: "regionCapacityExceeded" then controller sets backoff for 6m
ravi: provider API also returning 429s on quota query endpoint, looks like their quota API throttling is causing scale retries to back off
alex: suggested workaround: manual node creation in a different nodepool with spare reservation, then cordon+drain traffic to it
lina: procurement flagged some reserved capacity, not immediately available without approval
maya: can we hot-route public traffic to us-west-2 model shard while we sort this? devex confirmed model-compat for a short window
ops_lead: we can route ~50% non-enterprise traffic to us-west-2. enterprise routes need account owner approval or CS opt-in
cs_oncall: sending targeted notices to impacted enterprise owners requesting opt-in for failover routing
jonas: running manual create command for temporary nodes (attempt 1):
```
# manual attempt - try different machine family
gcloud compute instances create inf-temp-1 --zone=us-east1-b --machine-type=n1-highcpu-16 --count=6
```
ravi: create returns partial success: 3 nodes created, rest failed with "regionCapacityExceeded"
maya: implemented routing change: 50% public -> us-west-2, enterprise remains us-east-1 for now
alex: after routing change, overall queue load in us-east-1 dropped to 62%, public p95 latency improved to 1.1s
ops_lead: opening emergency quota ticket with provider; escalation ID PROVIDER-3321. Asking for capacity release or temporary reservation
ops_lead: ETA from provider support ~ 20-30 minutes per initial contact
jonas: applied a temporary autoscaler controller patch to treat 429/regionCapacityExceeded as retriable without entering long backoff. Patch pushed to controller in prod as hotfix
ravi: after hotfix, controller resumed scale attempts and successfully provisioned additional nodes from a different machine family (total +8 nodes after retries)
maya: also paused non-critical batch jobs and background re-indexing to free capacity
cs_oncall: notifying customers that mitigations are in place, providing 30min ETA for full recovery; account teams alerted
alex: monitoring: queue now 29% in us-east-1, system errors trending back to baseline, enterprise p95 latency ~1.9s
lina: procurement confirmed they can release some reserved capacity in 45m, but we got temporary provisioning so immediate risk reduced
ops_lead: owners assigned: ops_lead (coord), jonas (autoscaler fix), ravi (node ops), maya (routing + CS comms), sam (postmortem lead)
sam: assembling timeline, logs, PD alerts, provider ticket thread, controller commits
jonas: note: root cause sketch - provider-side capacity limits + provider API throttling led to autoscaler entering an extended backoff; our controller did not tolerate transient 429s gracefully
maya: mitigations taken: cross-region failover for public routes, manual node creation, autoscaler hotfix, paused non-essential workloads, procurement escalation
cs_oncall: sent follow-ups to impacted enterprise accounts; holding off further routing changes until owners respond
ops_lead: we'll keep watch for 1 hour. if provider doesn't confirm capacity increase, escalate to infra director and consider expanding failover to selected enterprise routes with CS sign-off
alex: bridge will remain open for now, moving to mitigated->watch when stable for 20m
incident-bot: incident-4287654321 status -> mitigated (watch)
pagerduty-bot: incident-4287654321 acknowledged by maya, resolved by ops_lead (watch)
sam: will draft postmortem in 24h, include timeline, diff of controller patch, provider ticket, and customer comms
maya: good job team. keep this thread for any regression. :raised_hands:
